scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build -w functions
scripts.test: vitest run tests/domain.test.ts tests/photos.test.ts tests/draft.test.ts tests/tree.test.tsx tests/admin.test.tsx
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build -w functions && node scripts/test-emulators.mjs
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-mi-arbol
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown src functions/src scripts tests *.ts *.json *.rules .github/workflows/*.yml README.md
scripts.local:backend: npm run build -w functions && node scripts/local-backend.mjs
